Title: Procurement BI Engineer II
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. What you will do? Job Scope & Purpose Join us in the Procurement Execution Center as a BI Engineer II. In this role, you will be responsible for implementing best-in-class Business Intelligence by deploying business analytics, data visualization, data modeling, data mining and infrastructure to help the organization make more data-driven decisions. The BI Engineer is expected to scope, analyze, develop, automate, enhance, and validate BI reporting & analytics, and dashboard solutions in a timely manner. How you will do it? Essential Job Responsibilities Transform medium complexity data sets into meaningful conclusions and recommendations, Develop, design, and maintain interactive dashboards on Power Bi or other visualization tools. Produce and maintain scaled, automated, user-friendly reporting systems and dashboards. Support the data visualization process by monitoring and tuning queries and data loads, addressing user questions concerning data integrity, and troubleshooting functional and technical issues. Design and build of business-critical reports such as Scorecards and Compliance reports. Work with end users to understand their conceptual needs to production. Clearly understand and document conceptual requirements and build/request the data models needed to deliver the final report. Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, and analyses used to drive key business decisions per the Execution Center plan. Support annual activities and RFPs for Procurement Categories (i.e. Logistics, MRO, Professional Svcs, Fleet, etc.) by performing data extraction, data cleansing, and data prep for bidding purposes. Trains the Stakeholders from the corresponding business group by creating their dashboard together with them and by boosting our Dashboards usage. Other duties as assigned by your Manager. What we look for? Position Requirements Bachelor’s degree in related field (Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science or similar) 4 + years of relevant experience in Business Intelligence, BI Data Engineering or other related fields Medium SQL skills for acquiring and transforming data Proficiency to draw insights from data and clearly communicate (verbal/written) information to stakeholders and senior management as required Experience configuring and using Power BI applications to effectively visualize and demonstrate proposed user interface dashboard and scorecard solutions. Experience in developing, maintaining and managing Power BI dashboards & analytics. Understanding of high-level programming languages. Python preferred. Ability to analyze and extract relevant information from large, complicated data sets of structured and unstructured data. Ability to adhere to plan developments, resolve roadblocks and adhere deadlines in a competing priorities environment. Demonstrate ability to story tell with data, as well as identify and root-cause both outliers and critical errors within the data. Demonstrate ability to identify and implement change, drive results, provide value-added analysis to assist Procurement leaders make informed decisions. Given the global nature of the role, advanced English is a must. Title: AI Product Manager
Industries: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
Description: Position Summary: The AI Product Manager defines and delivers artificial intelligence products and capabilities that improve operational efficiency, decision-making, customer experience, and employee productivity. This role partners with business and technology teams to identify high-value opportunities, translate business needs into clear product requirements, and guide AI solutions from discovery through adoption and continuous improvement. The position also helps establish responsible AI practices, measurable outcomes, and scalable product standards across ProTrans International’s U.S. and Mexico operations. Key Responsibilities Partner with business leaders and users to identify, prioritize, and validate AI use cases based on customer need, business value, technical feasibility, data readiness, risk, cost, and strategic alignment. Identify and deliver AI solutions supporting transportation management, shipment visibility and execution, pricing, carrier performance, customer service, exception management, document processing, and operational automation. Translate business problems into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, model inputs and outputs, fallback logic, process changes, and measurable success criteria. Partner with data engineering, analytics, data science, architecture, and security teams to define requirements for data quality, availability, governance, labeling, pipelines, and feedback loops. Design and oversee discovery, experiments, proofs of concept, pilots, controlled rollouts, launch planning, adoption, and continuous improvement. Define and monitor business and AI performance measures, including adoption, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, return on investment, model accuracy, precision, recall, error and hallucination rates, reliability, latency, and drift, as applicable. Establish responsible AI controls covering privacy, security, fairness, explainability, data protection, human oversight, transparency, acceptable use, deployment thresholds, and regulatory compliance. Evaluate build-versus-buy-versus-partner options and guide selection of AI platforms, vendors, copilots, automation tools, and custom solutions. Work with engineering and data science teams on model evaluation, production readiness, versioning, monitoring, rollback and fallback plans, and ongoing model lifecycle management. Develop strategies that increase user trust, understanding, transparency, adoption, and effective use of AI-enabled solutions through communication, documentation, education, and change management. Communicate product vision, trade-offs, progress, performance, risks, and launch plans to senior leaders, delivery teams, users, and external partners. Minimum Requirements 3-5 years of product management, technology product ownership, business systems, or related experience, including experience delivering data-driven or AI-enabled products preferred. Experience defining product strategy and roadmaps, conducting customer discovery, managing backlogs, writing requirements, prioritizing features, and leading cross-functional delivery. Working knowledge of machine learning concepts, supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, generative AI, large language models, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, vector search, APIs, intelligent automation, and cloud AI services. Understanding of data pipelines, data quality, training and evaluation data, feedback loops, model limitations, experimentation, monitoring, drift, and probabilistic system behavior. Ability to evaluate AI opportunities, explain technical concepts to business audiences, and balance customer value, usability, cost, technical feasibility, data readiness, scalability, and risk. Experience with product analytics, experimentation, A/B testing, KPI definition, value realization, or benefit tracking preferred. Experience with responsible AI, AI governance frameworks, data privacy, security, model risk, compliance, or regulated technology environments preferred. Familiarity with SQL, Python, data visualization tools, Azure AI or comparable cloud AI platforms, and product management tools preferred; hands-on model development is not required. Strong analytical, organizational, facilitation, communication, change-management, and stakeholder-management skills. Transportation, logistics, supply chain, freight management, carrier management, or operations experience preferred; bilingual English/Spanish preferred. Education And Experience Bachelor’s degree in Product Management, Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Relevant product management, agile, cloud, data, or AI certification preferred. This role does not provide direct supervision to direct reports and is onsite in the Monterrey office 2 days; working remote 3 days. Supervisory Responsibilities: This role does not provide direct supervision to direct reports. Competencies AI Product Strategy, Portfolio & Lifecycle Management Customer Discovery, Market Analysis & Business Value Prioritization Data Strategy, Analytics & AI/ML Fluency Experimentation, Model Evaluation & Product Analytics Responsible AI, Security, Privacy & Data Protection Agile Delivery & Cross-Functional Leadership Build-Buy-Partner & Vendor Management Executive Communication & Stakeholder Alignment Change Management, User Trust & Adoption Transportation & Logistics Process Understanding Travel 0-25% Language Skills: This role requires superior verbal and written communication skills in English (Spanish is also preferred). Physical Demands: This position requires the ability to work with a computer for long periods of time.
